lesson_metadata.title: Lexical Precision in Writing Task 2
lesson_metadata.subtitle: From adequate vocabulary (Band 6) to sufficient range with precision (Band 7)

learning_outcomes: Distinguish the gap between Band 6 and Band 7 in Lexical Resource
Use 15+ high-value academic collocations accurately in Task 2 writing
Correct collocation errors in own writing
Replace informal lexis with academic equivalents
Write a Band 7-level Task 2 body paragraph

warm_up.description: 10 sentences with collocation errors. Learner corrects in 5 minutes.
warm_up.key_insight: Band 6 learners know individual words. Band 7 learners know how words combine accurately.

parts: Band 6 vs Band 7 Lexical Resource descriptor comparison
Demonstration with Band 6 vs Band 7 sentences
presentation.key_message: Band 7 is not about harder words; it is about more precise words in natural combinations.

activities: Register conversion (5 informal sentences to academic)

production.task: Write one Task 2 body paragraph (80-120 words) using at least 4 target collocations

homework.writing_task: Full Task 2 essay (250+ words) using 8+ target collocations
homework.error_log: Add all collocation errors to error log

if_too_easy: Rewrite sample paragraph to Band 8 standard
Analyse 5 less common collocations from authentic sources
if_too_hard: Focus on one weakness at a time

copyright_note: All practice sentences, error examples, and sample paragraphs are ORIGINAL and teacher-written. No IELTS test questions or copyrighted passages have been reproduced.
